<thought>The carbon NMR spectrum shows ten distinct chemical shift values (168.30, 130.70, 130.27, 128.35, 126.66, 124.85, 123.57, 58.70, 36.40, 26.40). Each distinct shift corresponds to a unique carbon environment, so there are 10 chemically equivalent carbon types.</thought>
<final_answer>10</final_answer>
